label: PCA comparator (dosage · θπ · GHSL)
legacy_source: n/a — new in this commit; not in legacy/Inversion_atlas.html
purpose: Cross-evidence comparator. Three synchronized mini-PCA panels at the active window (state.cur), one per evidence axis (dosage / θπ / GHSL). K-band coloring inherits from the anchor's clustering so each sample keeps its band color across panels. Hover a dot to highlight it in all 3. ←/→ scrubs all 3 windows in lock-step. Phase 1 = side-by-side; Phase 2 + 3 (per-sample 3-axis trajectory and Procrustes overlay) deferred per SPEC.

panels.purpose: Native dosage PCA at the active window (always available)
θπ local PCA at the active window (optional layer; shows 'absent' status when not loaded)
GHSL local PCA at the active window (optional layer)
window label + Mb badge + anchor selector + hovered-sample readout

subdir_files: renderer.js — paintPanel + findSampleAtPixel; layer accessors for the 3 data sources; retina-correct canvas fit
primitives_used: pages/discovery/local_pca_dosage/_data.js → groupColor, getL2Cluster (K-band coloring from the dosage anchor)

interactions.purpose: pick which evidence axis drives the K-band palette
hover dot → highlight in all 3 panels

specs_todo: specs_todo/SPEC_local_pca_comparator.md (design exploration; Phase 1 shipped, Phases 2 + 3 still proposed)

known_issues: Phase 1 only — Procrustes overlay (Phase 3) NOT implemented; the 3 panels show their native coordinate spaces (no rotation).

anchor selector currently informational — all 3 anchor options pull K-band labels from the dosage K-means since θπ + GHSL don't yet ship their own clusterings. The dropdown will activate once those layers land.
θπ + GHSL panels show 'absent' status when their layer is not loaded (theta_pi_local_pca / ghsl_panel.local_pca). dosage panel always renders.
slab-mode aggregation (compareUnit ∈ {win5, win10}) not honoured — Phase 1 uses the cursor window only.
